steps.instruction: From the lift lobby, follow the corridor toward the end window. Stop beside the glass frontage marked Office for Research & Innovation on your left.
steps.landmark: Office for Research & Innovation sign on the glass frontage beside the corridor

steps.instruction: Continue along the same corridor to the toilet entrance on your right, marked by wheelchair symbols beside a louvered door. Stop outside the entrance.
steps.landmark: Two wheelchair symbols on wood paneling beside the louvered toilet entrance
